Why choose Algarve Pain Centre

The right team by your side at every step

From first assessment to long-term follow-up, you are supported by a coordinated, multidisciplinary team focused on relieving your pain and restoring your quality of life.

Specialised multidisciplinary team

Pain medicine, spine surgery, sports medicine, stroke care and rehabilitation working together, so your treatment plan is built from multiple expert perspectives, not just one.

Personalised treatment pathways

We start with the least invasive options and only escalate when it is clinically necessary, combining medication, targeted procedures and rehabilitation tailored to your goals and lifestyle.

Advanced, evidence-based techniques

Access to modern procedures such as radiofrequency, vertebroplasty, spinal interventions and ultrasound-guided injections, always aligned with international best-practice guidelines.

Continuity and clear communication

Your care team follows you over time, explains each step in clear language and coordinates with your other doctors, so you never feel alone in your treatment journey.

Care without shortcuts

Every patient story is different. We take the time to understand yours, build a plan around your daily life and help you move with confidence again.

Frequently asked questions

Answers to common questions about our pain clinic in the Algarve

Choosing a pain clinic is an important decision. These answers cover what we treat, how appointments work and what to expect when you visit us in Vale do Lobo.

What types of pain conditions do you treat?

We treat a wide range of conditions including spine pain, joint pain, nerve pain, headaches, sports injuries and post‑stroke symptoms. If you are unsure whether your condition fits, our team can review your situation and guide you to the right specialist.

Do I need a referral to book an appointment?

A formal referral is not always required. Many patients contact Algarve Pain Centre directly, while others are referred by their family doctor or another specialist. If you already have scans or reports, bringing them to your visit helps us avoid repeating tests.

Do you see international patients visiting the Algarve?

Yes. We regularly care for patients who live abroad or spend part of the year in Portugal. Our clinic team can help you coordinate appointments and treatment around your travel schedule, and we share information with your doctors at home when needed.

What should I expect from my first consultation?

Your first visit usually lasts long enough for a detailed discussion of your symptoms, examination and review of previous investigations. By the end we aim to give you a clear explanation of your condition, outline immediate steps and propose a longer‑term plan tailored to your goals.
